class.name: TextInsertionTemplate
class.brief_description: A text with placeholders, parsed once by [TextInsertionServer].

method.name: get_names
method.description: Returns the names of the placeholders in the text, each name once, in the order of first use.

method.name: get_source
method.description: Returns the text the template was parsed from.

method.name: has_name
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the text has a placeholder for [param name].
